subject: [PATCH v3 3/8] mm/mmzone: read each zoneref slot once when filtering by nodemask

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch fixes a kernel NULL pointer dereference bug by reading each zoneref slot only once when filtering by nodemask. The problem occurred because the code was reading the same slot twice, which could return a NULL zone after offlining its last block. This caused a crash when trying to access the node of a NULL zone. The patch fixes this issue by testing the zone directly in the first read and returning immediately if it's NULL.
